name: clawd-pet
description: Clawd, a pixel-art pet above the prompt that acts out each tool call, plus an HP/MP/ST HUD below it

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How quickly the pet runs and animates.

sleepAfter.title: Sleep after (seconds)
sleepAfter.description: Idle time before the pet falls asleep. 0 keeps it awake.

hud.title: HUD
hud.description: The HP, MP, and ST bars below the prompt.

hudStyle.title: HUD style
hudStyle.description: window: the framed HUD with token counts, forecasts, and the session's cost. line: one unframed row, for a small terminal.

targets.title: Name files and commands
targets.description: The status line names the file, pattern, command, host, or search query a tool works on. Turn it off to share your screen.

minis.title: Subagent minis
minis.description: A mini behind the pet for each running subagent.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: A recap when a long turn ends, and a warning when context, a rate limit, or a run of tool calls goes wrong.

notifyAfter.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfter.description: A turn at least this long ends with a desktop notification, for when you have looked away. 0 turns it off.

shellStatus.title: Shell status
shellStatus.description: Write what each session is doing to ~/.cache/clawd-pet, for the clawd-pet zsh plugin to show in your prompt.
